title: An International Patient-led Registry in Fibrotic Interstitial Lung Diseases Using eHealth Technology
brief_summary: The I-FILE study is a prospective multicenter, multinational observational study where the feasibility of a patient-led registry using home monitoring in patients with pulmonary fibrosis will be evaluated. The aim of the study is to gain more insights in disease behavior in patients with pulmonary fibrosis, so in future patients with progressive disease can be better identified.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Newly diagnosed patients with F-ILD according to the ATS/ERS criteria by a multidisciplinary ILD team :

* MDT diagnosis ≤ 6 months before inclusion
* Treatment for F-ILD ≤ than 1 month

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not able to speak, read or write in the native language of the country where the patient is included
* Not able to comply to the study protocol, according to the judgement of the investigator and/or patient
* No access to internet
study_population: 500 untreated patients with a diagnosis of F-ILD in ILD expert centers in 5 European countries
